second-mixin-declaration.describes: a SECOND `@mixin <name>` in the same file — it replaces the first (Sass: last wins)

second-function-declaration.describes: a SECOND `@function <name>` in the same file

variable-assigned-twice.describes: a `$var` assigned more than once in the same file (Sass reassignment)

forward-statement.describes: a `@forward` — the module system statement that re-exports another module's members

extend-statement.describes: an `@extend` — the only inheritance-shaped construct Sass has

placeholder-selector-declared.describes: a `%placeholder` selector DEFINED in a rule_set — Sass's own name for it is a placeholder that only becomes a selector once `@extend`ed

call-expression-named-function.describes: a `call_expression` whose callee is a `@function` this file DECLARES
